scope: Original complete 406090 world renderer, including native BSP, sprite ordering, panorama, palette shading, mip selection and original pixel writers. Controlled camera sequences and flag/pod texture frames at 320x240 and 640x480; mirror views at 232x172. Mask excludes untouched framebuffer edges and original reads outside supplied texture allocations. No whole-game simulation, HUD or OS presentation parity is claimed.
